description: The pie chart titled “Distribution of data source in the AttrEval-Simulation” shows how the dataset is divided among different data sources, with 6 slices in total. The slices are labeled ENTITYQUEST (blue) at about 26.0%, HOTPOTQA (red) at about 24.2%, TRIVIAQA (orange) at about 22.7%, POPQA (yellow) at about 21.6%, an unlabeled small slice (green) at about 1.9%, and WEBQUESTIO (teal) at about 3.6%. Percentage values are displayed next to each label with leader lines pointing to the corresponding slice, there is no separate legend, and none of the slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized; the segments do not appear strictly ordered by size around the circle.
